figma-local.description: Local Figma MCP server running through Figma Desktop app. Requires Figma Desktop installed with Dev Mode enabled. No authentication needed for local connections.

figma-remote.description: Remote Figma MCP server (cloud-based). Requires FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable. Available on all Figma plans. To enable: 1) Generate token at figma.com/settings, 2) export FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN='your_token', 3) set enabled to true
